title: Payment Cutoff and Autopay Choices on Ridgeline Consumer Credit Accounts
content:
Ridgeline Consumer Credit sets one daily payment cutoff, a list of automatic payment amounts the cardholder may choose, and the lead time an autopay enrollment or change needs before a payment due date.

| | Card Classic | Card Preferred | Card Premier | Project Loan 66 | Project Loan 78 | Project Loan 84 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Payment cutoff, Eastern Time, on a business day (24-hour clock) | 17:00 | 17:00 | 17:00 | 17:00 | 17:00 | 17:00 |
| Autopay amounts the cardholder may choose | minimum due, statement balance, fixed amount | minimum due, statement balance, fixed amount | minimum due, statement balance, fixed amount | minimum due, fixed amount | minimum due, fixed amount | minimum due, fixed amount |
| Autopay change lead time (business days before the due date) | 3 | 3 | 3 | 3 | 3 | 3 |

## Questions answered

**Can a Ridgeline Project Loan borrower choose to have the full statement balance drafted?** No. The statement balance option is listed only for the three Ridgeline Consumer Credit Card tiers; the Project Loan tiers list the minimum due and a fixed amount.

**What does the 17:00 cutoff refer to?** It is the Eastern Time cutoff on a business day for a payment to be credited that day.

**What is the lead time counted in?** Business days before the payment due date by which an autopay enrollment or change must be made to apply to that due date: 3 on every tier.
